biotools.summary: DeepMSA2 is a pipeline that generates high-quality multiple sequence alignments (MSAs) for protein monomers and complexes by leveraging large-scale genomic and metagenomic datasets, significantly improving the accuracy of protein tertiary and quaternary structure predictions.
